messages:
jess: Quick sync on gateway behavior for stalled streams. We need a clear contract: when do we switch, when do we hedge, and when do we fail up to the client?

omar: Short answer: prefer switch-over (start new upstream) over speculative merge by default. Merge should be opt-in and only for read-only routes.

ev an: spelled evan.

ev an: ha, typo. evan: Agree. Add two signals: progress (sequence/token advancement) and liveness (heartbeats). Switch decision must be based on lack of progress, not missing heartbeats.

jess: Proposed thresholds: progress_timeout=800ms, stall_window=2s. If no seq advance > progress_timeout but heartbeats exist, wait until stall_window then switch.

omar: We also need idempotency policy. For non-idempotent routes, no automatic retries or hedges. If side-effects are unknown, treat as nondurable and fail-fast.

ev an: Implementation detail: gateway generates an internal resume handle per request and maps it to upstream resume tokens. Clients never see upstream tokens; they only get our opaque handle if they reconnect.

jess: Good. For mergeable streams, require upstream headers/frames: X-RW-Fragment-Id, X-RW-Seq-Start, X-RW-Seq-End, X-RW-Checksum. Gateway will dedupe overlapping fragments by checksum.

omar: Also add a max_parallel hedges config (default 1) and a per-route flag hedging: disabled|switch_only|mergeable. Default for hosted public routes = disabled.

ev an: Observability: emit events switch_initiated, hedge_started, fragment_rejected(checksum), fragment_accepted. Trace spans: gateway.attempt.<n> and gateway.finalization pointing to upstream chosen. Console should collapse hedged attempts.

jess: Billing note: attempt token counts should be recorded separately but normalized in UI to show final tokens billed to the customer. Keep raw attempted counts in infra metrics for cost accounting.

omar: Edge-case: upstream that supports resume but returns inconsistent seq anchors after a resume. Gateway should detect checksum mismatch and abort merge, then fall back to fail-fast and return trailer error.

ev an: Action items: jess update routing RFC with hedging modes, resume-handle mapping, and fragment header spec. omar draft test harness for checksum mismatch and stalled-heartbeat scenarios. nora design Console mock for collapsed hedges. ci-bot: CI lint passed for hedging rfc draft #5120 :white_check_mark:
